note: Regional park on the south shore of Atton's Lake, about 20 km NE of Cut Knife off Hwy 40. Private cabins stand between the RV loops and the beach. Seasonal sites are let by contract, and overflow non-serviced sites take 40-ft rigs. 9-hole golf course, concession, sand beach, boat launch. ATVs are banned in the park in June, July and August, and motorboats on summer weekends. --Claude
summary: Keep (local, nightly majority). Let's Camp sells 55 numbered sites (53 electric 15/20/30 A + water, 2 non-serviced) plus 60 overflow non-serviced sites by the night; ~32 numbered sites missing from Let's Camp are presumably the contract seasonals. No sewer at sites. Season May 7 - Sep 30 (guide: May 12). Rates tax-in C$20-37.50, entry C$8/day. PIN MOVE ~430 m: stored point sits in a cabin area SW of the loops -> 52.8368,-108.8565. Not waterfront kept. Website SRP link redirects -> attons-lake-2. Google 4.5 (104).
